newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Guthrie raises Interform Ceramics stake.
newsitem.headline: Guthrie raises Interform Ceramics stake.

text.p: Guthrie GTS Ltd said on Monday it had acquired an additional 33.66 million shares of Interform Ceramics Technologies Ltd.

The acquisition, through Guthrie wholly-owned subsidiary Lao Hotel (H.K.) Ltd at a total consideration of HK$40.79 million, brought Guthrie's total stake in Interform to 142.42 million shares, representing approximately 7.2 percent of the Guthrie Group's net tangible assets.
Interform is principally involved in the design, supply and installation of ceramics production lines in China.
Guthrie is the holding company of a group of companies engaged in mechanical and engineering contracting and property investment and development.
Interform shares closed at HK$1.23 in Hong Kong on Monday.
